en: Can you contact him?

I have some questions I'd like
to ask him regarding the Chinese.

Nope. He said he'd give me a call
if he ever needs something.
He didn't leave me any contact info.

Either way, how is talking to
Akiyama going to help you?

When we were together earlier, we fought
against a large Chinese man named Ed.
I'd bet he's a Saio officer.

If anyone can tell me where that
guy might be, it's Akiyama.

And once I find Ed, I want to ask him
why the Saio killed Tatsukawa.

I understand. But you know that's
law enforcement's job, right?
Well, not like that's ever stopped you.
Regardless, I need some answers, too.

How Tatsukawa ended up in Kamurocho,
his disposition, his interactions with Haruka.
Anything helps.
Sorry, just doing my job.

That Date fella ain't half bad.
He's still real sharp fer an old fart.
Seems real trustworthy, too.

Right. Maybe we should leave
all o' this to Date-san.

He might be able to find out
why Tatsukawa had to die like that.

I'm sure he could, but I need to know now.
The earlier we learn the truth, the better.

I'm not going to just sit around
here and wait for things to happen.
Why're you in such a hurry?

With the police on the Tatsukawa case,
our trail is going to get cut off soon.

Outside of Date-san, the force doesn't
take half measures here.

Earlier today, a detective named Honjo
was already treating me like a suspect.
I need to take care of this before it's too late.

I'm going to start by looking for Akiyama.
I'll start with his sewer hideout from before.

You should stay here in the meantime.
Just make sure I can reach you.

We'll keep an eye out while yer gone,
so y'can do what needs doin'.
Kiryu-aniki. Be careful out there.
Who are you?

[Surround him! Don't let him escape!
This is where he dies!]

The Chinese? I guess you've been
waiting for Akiyama to come back.
Guess negotiations are off the table.

[I'll slice you up!
The yakuza are done for!]

[Dammit, who is this guy!?
Come on, let's get out of here!]

You're still here. Shouldn't you be
running away with your friends?

Hold on, Kiryu-san. It's me.
You remember?

Oh, you're the guy who showed me
this place a while back.

Thank god you recognize me. I was worried
you were gonna start punching <font_kind=yakuza_italic>me</font_kind> soon.
But Kiryu-san, what are you doing here?

Akiyama-san hasn't come back down to
these sewers since he left with you.
I need to get in touch with him again.
Do you know how to reach him?
I do, but it'll take a bit of time.
Akiyama-san's super careful.

You've gotta go through a whole web of
people if you ever wanna contact him.

Right. After all, the triads
still have him in their crosshairs.

Honestly, I think he should just get outta
Kamurocho entirely if it's that bad.

Anyway, do you think you could
tell Akiyama to give me a call?
Can do. Just give me some time.
Okay. Thanks.

(There's nothing for me to do now but walk
around town and wait for Akiyama to call...)

(Hm? They blocked the exit.
I guess I have to go the other way...)
This is Kiryu.

It's Akiyama. Sorry it's so tough to reach me.
I heard you want something?
I do. Where are you right now?

Let's just say I'm on the move.
Still in Kamurocho, though.
Great. There's something I need to ask you.

The other day, we fought against that
triad guy, Ed, remember?
How high up the ladder do you think he is?
You mean in the Saio?

I'm pretty certain he's an officer. He's one
of the few who talks to their boss directly.

I thought so.
I want to speak to him.
Do you have any idea where he is?

You wanna talk to Ed?
But why?

The Saio Triad might've been involved
in Haruka's accident in some way.
Ed should be in Little Asia.

He's the head honcho of that
huge building in the middle, but... Hm...

If you just stroll in asking to talk to Ed,
you'll have an ice cube's chance in hell.

That place is the Saio Triad nerve center.
May as well walk up and declare war.
If that's what it takes, so be it.

Not exactly what I wanna hear from
a guy who says he's gone clean.

Anyway, it's clear we need to talk.
Are you free now?

Is that okay?
Where to?

Over in Theater Square, there's an APA Hotel.
Meet me up on the sixth floor.
Kiryu-san, you're alone, right?
Yeah, I am.
Great. I'll head over, then.

Oh, and try to make sure you don't
get followed this time, Kiryu-san?
Heh. You got it.
(Time to go meet Akiyama.)

(This is the APA Hotel. Akiyama said
he'd be on the sixth floor.)

(It looks like I'm being followed, but they
clearly won't start a fight out in public.)

(I need to take care of them before
I can go up to meet Akiyama, though.)

(Maybe I should walk over to somewhere
more secluded so we can "chat" a bit.)
(Theater Alley would be the perfect place.)

So you're the ones who have
been following me?
So much for talking.
Wait, these are Tojo men?

What's going on here?
Why is the Tojo Clan following me?

(I'm in the clear now.
I should go meet up with Akiyama.)

(That door is open.
Am I supposed to go in there?)
Akiyama!?
Hey. Kinda like a spy, yeah?
Sad part is that I'm not joking.

You say that, but it looks like
you're enjoying yourself.

On a more serious note, it's been a real
pain for me to get around Kamurocho.

Plus, today I thought I should play it
extra safe. I have a guest with me.
A guest?
I'm Murota from the Jinsei Family.

I still haven't forgotten what you did
for me in that alleyway, Kiryu-san.
Wait... Why are you here?

Well, Murota-kun and I started talking
when he saw through my disguise.

He mentioned how he led you to me when
I was living in the sewer, and we hit it off.

Apparently the triads aren't the only
ones we need to be worrying about.

Sugai from the Tojo Clan
is just as dangerous.

But anyway, it might be best for you to hear
all the details directly from Murota-kun.
What can you tell me?
Man, you really are the fourth chairman!

It was a huge shock when I realized
who you were after you saved me.

Anyway, the Tojo Clan execs are annoyed
that you're back. Almost more of a panic.

Well right now, control of the Tojo Clan rests
with Acting Chairman Sugai and Someya.

Of course, that's only because
the sixth chairman was arrested.

Speaking of his arrest, I've heard rumors
that the whole thing was planned.

Let me explain from the beginning.
First we had that arson in Little Asia.

Several fires flared up at the same time,
yet they still couldn't make a single arrest.

At that point, the only group who could carry
out such a coordinated plan was the Tojo Clan.

You're telling me the Tojo Clan
burned down Little Asia?

Exactly. After the fire, Little Asia was ripe
for the Saio Triad to move into the ruins.
That's when the turf war erupted.

When that conflict escalated, the cops blamed
the Tojo Clan sixth chairman and arrested him.

The power vacuum that arrest created was
soon filled by a lifelong advisor, Sugai-san.

Rumor has it,
Sugai was in bed with the Saio Triad.

The point of the Little Asia fire was to
create a space the Saio could move into.

And the "war" he incited was all staged
in order to bring down the sixth chairman.

So imagine how Sugai must've felt when you
showed up just as he drove Daigo-san out.

It's no surprise he wanted to keep
his distance from you, Kiryu-san.

If you had realized what actually happened,
you might've come to avenge Daigo-san.

I thought it'd be pretty important for
you to know about this, Fourth Chairman.

Please try to be extra careful
around Sugai and Someya.

Funny you say that. I got attacked
by some Tojo guys on my way here.

It looks like these rumors of yours
aren't very far from the truth.

I appreciate you telling me all this, Murota.
I owe you one.

Not at all.
Anyway, I should be going.

Murota's not the only one in the Tojo Clan
who thinks the rumors are true.

But with Sugai and Someya watching their
every move, nobody can say anything.
And what are your thoughts?
About Sugai and the Saio conspiring?

At a bare minimum, I know they
really want to kill each other now.

Even if the war started as some kind of act,
it's blossomed into something very real now.
Kamurocho's such a goddamn mess.

Even if I wanted to reopen Sky Finance,
it'd be totally impossible in this climate.
You'd reopen Sky Finance?

Well, I only started it up to give loans
to those who dreamed of saving this city.

This place picked me back up when I was
at rock bottom, so it's only fair I repay it.

But not only is it apparently open-season on
crime, but the Jingweon are on a spending spree.

As you might have heard,
even Stardust fell victim to that.
Yeah, I've heard.

If there's any hope left in this town, it's
because the Dragon of Dojima has returned.
Yeah right.

I know, I know. Putting an end to this conflict
is probably the last thing on your mind.

But to be blunt with you,
I kinda hope you'll do it anyway.
Sorry. That was selfish of me.
I've looked into Little Asia.

Kicking down the front door may not
be the only way to get to Ed.
There's an alternate route.
An alternate route?

One that'll help us avoid
the Saio mob at the entrance.
They'll never see us coming.

By the way, what is it you're
hoping to ask Ed?

I want to know why the Saio Triad
killed a man named Tatsukawa.
Tatsukawa?

An ex-yakuza from Onomichi. More recently,
he was working as a Saio Triad informant.
Beyond that, he's apparently Haruto's dad.

Huh? You're saying Haruka-chan got with
a guy like that? No way.

I have my doubts too. That's why I
want to have a talk with Ed.

I get you. Okay then,
I'll help you get into Little Asia.

Yeah, I'll be fine. Let's meet up
again near the border of Little Asia.
I'd feel better with more guys, though...

Actually, I have two friends from Onomichi
that I can bring with me.

Perfect. Sorry I keep dragging you all
around town. Anyway, I'll see you later.

(I should head back to Serena and
meet up with Nagumo and Yuta.)

I'm back.
Were you bored? Hm?
Kiryu-aniki. Sorry 'bout this.

Cap jus' wouldn't stop drinking.
Turns out he still had a soft spot for Tatsukawa.

I was kinda hoping t'drink myself, but he
downed it all before I got the chance.

Yeah, well... I know you two are feeling low...
But that sake's worth 50 grand.
One bottle is 50,000 yen.

Wait, what?
So ten is... 500,000!?
I did tell him to take it easy, didn't I?
Cap! Y'gotta get up! Hey!
...The hell?

Yuta, y'shit. Y'should've stopped me
way quicker, y'damn moron.
Tatsukawa ain't worth 500 grand.

Mama said she put it on our tab, so we can
figure out how to handle this later.

Fer now, we need to talk about Little Asia.
Right, Kiryu-aniki?
Right. Are you sober enough, Nagumo?
'Course I am.

I ain't one t'doze off while we're talkin'
'bout bustin' into the enemy base.

Speakin' of, one second yer pummelin'
a Korean host, the next yer onto the triads.

I like your style, Aniki.
Y'keep givin' me reasons t'whoop on guys!

Hold on a sec. This is the crew who
murdered Tatsukawa in cold blood, yeah?

Even if we do sneak into their base,
how're we gonna get out alive?

Y'goin' limp!? Think about what
we're doin' in Kamurocho t'begin with!
Why'd we come if it ain't worth dyin', huh!?
No, don't get careless.

Our lives <font_kind=yakuza_italic>are</font_kind> on the line here.
These guys won't think twice about murder.

All the same, this is how we're
gonna honor Tatsukawa's memory.
Y'best be ready t'get down, Yuta!

Damn straight.
Kiryu-aniki. Are you ready?

Yeah, it's about time.
Let's head to Little Asia.

All right! I'd follow ya t'the depths
o' hell n' back, Kiryu-aniki!

(Akiyama said to meet him outside of
Little Asia. We should get going...)

Aniki, this here's Little Asia. We're s'posed
t'be meetin' that Akiyama fella here, right?
I'm over here, Kiryu-san.
Follow me, but don't get too close.
Nagumo, Yuta. That's Akiyama.
Kiryu-san. Ed should be in there.

It won't be quite as direct, but my
alternate route should get us in unseen.
Come on, this way.

Hey, the name's Akiyama.
These your Hiroshima friends, Kiryu-san?

Yeah. Hirose Family Captain Nagumo
and one of his subordinates, Yuta.

Haruto's father Tatsukawa used to
be part of the Hirose Family as well.
I'm Nagumo.

And I'm Yuta Usami. Kiryu-aniki's told us
a lot about you, Akiyama-san.
He said yer a lender 'round these parts?

I was. I'm not much more than
a homeless bum nowadays.

That aside, lemme explain how we reach Ed.
This building will be our entry point.
From there we'll pass through a few others.
